neighbours.label: punctuation and identifiers in Python model/class-definition code (db.Column(...) field lines, Meta fields tuples)
fire:
class Order(db.Model):
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    total = db.Column(db.Float, nullable=False)
    note = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=True)

class Post(db.Model):
    title = db.Column(db.String(200), nullable=False)
    body = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=True)
    created = db.Column(db.DateTime, nullable=True)

class Item(db.Model):
    sku = db.Column(db.String(40), unique=True)
    price = db.Column(db.Numeric, nullable=False)
    stock = db.Column(db.Integer, default=0)

class Tag(db.Model):
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    name = db.Column(db.String(50), nullable=False)
    color = db.Column(db.String(7), nullable=True)

class Author(db.Model):
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    first = db.Column(db.String(60), nullable=False)
    last = db.Column(db.String(60), nullable=False)

class Review(db.Model):
    stars = db.Column(db.Integer, nullable=False)
    text = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=True)
    user_id = db.Column(db.Integer, nullable=False)

class Room(db.Model):
    number = db.Column(db.String(10), nullable=False)
    beds = db.Column(db.Integer, default=1)
    floor = db.Column(db.Integer, nullable=True)
quiet: The Order table has an id that is the primary key, a total that cannot be empty, and an optional note.
Each post has a title of up to two hundred characters, a body, and the date it was created.
Every item has a unique stock code, a price that must be set, and a stock count that starts at zero.
A tag has an id, a short name that is required, and an optional color written as a hex code.
An author record stores a first name and a last name, both of which are required fields.
For each visit we record the day, which is required, and optional start and end times.
A review stores the number of stars, an optional text, and the id of the user who wrote it.
Each room has a number, a count of beds that defaults to one, and an optional floor.
